newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market active at $65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market active at $65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active at mid-morning, otherwise slow, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady with Monday's decline.
Inquiry moderate, demand light to moderate. Sales confirmed on 15,100 slaughter steers and 13,500 slaughter heifers Tuesday.
For the week to date 46,800 head confirmed including 11,000 head or about 24% previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1325 lbs
